newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.9 pct -- BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.9 pct -- BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.9 percent in the week ended July 12 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.9 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index rose 1.0 percent from the prior month.
"The sales index continued to move higher and stood at its highest level since mid-May," it said. Sales were "on-to-above plan" as consumers purchased hot weather item goods, it said.
